title: Sitrep 4 — Water Advisory Continues

fields.incidentName: Water Line, No Drink — Do Not Drink Advisory
fields.summary: The 40,000-gallon potable water storage tank in the Central Plant remains at 34,900 gallons, with consumption stabilized at 1,150 gallons per hour. The city fill valve remains closed. Dialysis operations continue under contingency: four outpatient treatments have been relocated to a partner unit today; five others are scheduled for tomorrow. Twenty-four inpatients are accounted for: two transferred to a neighboring facility, three on continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) using sterile fluid, and 19 scheduled for portable RO units on bottled sterile water. Elective procedures remain cancelled. Sterile Processing has suspended all instrument reprocessing. Bottled water inventory stands at 1,800 cases. The city has not issued a time to lift the advisory and confirms that two clean sample sets are required, with flushing to follow. The hospital continues to operate under conservation and infection prevention protocols.

actions.text: Sitrep 3 issued, confirming advisory status and updated use rates.
Water hauling contractor confirmed delivery window: 11:30 with 6,000-gallon tankers every 3 hours.
Infection Prevention issued updated hand hygiene guidance: alcohol rub only, soap and water only with bottled water in high-risk areas.
Women and Infants 6 West received 200 additional ready-to-feed formula bottles and 100 L of sterile water for feeding and cleaning.

planned: Review criteria for resuming dialysis with NEPH and DFEM.
Confirm water hauling contract execution with Facilities and Security.
Update public messaging via PIO with new time estimates.
issues: No definitive end date for the Do Not Drink advisory.
Limited capacity for inpatient dialysis in neighboring facilities.
Ongoing pressure on sterile water and formula supplies for neonatal unit.
fields.approvedBy: D. Whitcomb, Director of Facilities and Emergency Management

instructorNote: This is a decision-point sitrep; the AOC must record the criteria for resuming dialysis and lifting conservation. Watch for a formal approval of the exit criteria.
